title: decode_line() emits partial result on decode error rather than propagating Err — correct design for tolerant parsing
description: The design choice in uuencoding/src/decode.rs to treat per-line decode errors as truncation (returning partial Ok) rather than hard Err is correct for the MIME context. Real-world mail archives from the 1990s frequently have one mangled data line out of dozens. Returning partial data with is_truncated=true is more useful than refusing to decode at all. A future contributor might argue this should be Err to fail loudly; that would be wrong for this use case. Preserve.
close_reason: Design decision confirmed correct: partial-Ok on decode error is right for tolerant MIME parsing. No code change.
